job.title: Facilities Manager
job.description:
Facilities Manager – SA State Government
Location: Mawson Lakes, SA
Employment: Full-time
Contract: ASAP - June 2027
Rate: $69–$71 per hour + superannuation
An exciting opportunity is available for an experienced Facilities Manager to join a South Australian State Government department based in Mawson Lakes.
This is a hands-on facilities and asset management role where you will play an important part in ensuring facilities are safe, well-maintained, compliant and operating effectively. You will work closely with contractors, suppliers, internal stakeholders and other government agencies to deliver high-quality facilities services and maintenance outcomes.
About the role As Facilities Manager, you will be responsible for the day-to-day management of facilities services, maintenance programs and external service providers across a portfolio of assets.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Managing facilities maintenance, including preventative maintenance, repairs, upgrades and improvement works.
  • Developing and managing facilities budgets, monitoring expenditure and identifying opportunities for cost efficiencies.
  • Managing relationships with contractors, suppliers and service providers to ensure quality, timely and compliant delivery.
  • Monitoring contractor performance against contracts, KPIs and service level expectations.
  • Conducting regular inspections and coordinating corrective actions to ensure facilities meet relevant building, safety and industry requirements.
  • Monitoring the condition and performance of buildings, plant and equipment and developing appropriate maintenance and replacement strategies.
  • Working with internal teams and external partners to plan and deliver facilities improvement projects.
  • Responding to and resolving facilities-related issues, complaints and stakeholder concerns.
  • Building strong relationships with a broad range of stakeholders and providing practical advice on facilities matters.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve facilities processes, systems and service delivery.
About you We are looking for an experienced facilities or property professional who can confidently manage competing priorities, contractors and stakeholder expectations.
You will ideally have:
  • Demonstrated experience in facilities, property or asset management.
  • Strong experience managing contractors, suppliers and service providers.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience managing budgets and monitoring expenditure.
  • Strong knowledge of facilities maintenance, compliance and building requirements.
  • The ability to identify issues, assess options and implement practical solutions.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a busy environment.
  • Relevant tertiary qualifications in property or a related discipline are highly desirable, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Property Manager Registration is required.
What’s on offer?
  • Full-time opportunity with a South Australian State Government department.
  • Based in Mawson Lakes.
  • Attractive hourly rate of $69–$71 per hour + superannuation.
  • Opportunity to work across a varied property and facilities portfolio.
  • A role with significant stakeholder engagement and responsibility.
  • The opportunity to contribute to the effective management and improvement of government assets.
A current satisfactory National Police Clearance will be required for the successful candidate. Some out-of-hours work and interstate/intrastate travel may also be required.
If you are an experienced Facilities Manager looking for your next opportunity within South Australian Government, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Senior Business Analyst (Dynamics 365)
job.description:
A leading financial services organisation is looking for an experienced Senior Business Analyst / D365 Functional Consultant to take ownership of business and technical analysis across a range of Dynamics 365 initiatives.

This is a highly collaborative role, working across business stakeholders, Product Owners, Solution Architects, Developers, Testers, Data teams and third-party technology partners to translate complex business needs into practical, scalable technology solutions.
What you'll be doing
  • Lead end-to-end business analysis across Dynamics 365 and Power Platform initiatives, from discovery through to implementation and transition to support.
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business problems, define target outcomes and establish solution scope.
  • Elicit, analyse and prioritise functional, data, integration, reporting, security and non-functional requirements.
  • Map current and future-state processes, customer journeys, business rules, data flows and system interactions.
  • Translate business requirements into Dynamics 365 functional requirements, including entities, data structures, forms, views, workflows, automation and reporting.
  • Facilitate workshops and design sessions with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Work closely with Solution Architects and D365 Developers to ensure requirements are technically feasible and aligned with platform standards.
  • Support data migration and integration activities, including data mapping, cleansing, reconciliation and API requirements.
  • Define acceptance criteria and support system, integration and UAT testing, including defect triage and implementation readiness.
  • Produce high-quality analysis and documentation while contributing to continuous improvement across BA and delivery practices.
What we're looking for We're looking for a Senior BA who combines strong business analysis capability with genuine Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM knowledge.

You'll have:
  • 7+ years' experience as a Business Analyst delivering complex technology and business change, including hands on experience implementing & uplifting Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM.
  • Strong understanding of D365 concepts including configuration, customisation, entities, data models, forms, views, workflows, security roles and solution lifecycle.
  • Experience with the Microsoft Power Platform, particularly Power Apps, Power Automate and Power BI.
  • Experience defining requirements for APIs, third-party integrations, data migration, reporting and identity/access management.
  • Strong process modelling, requirements elicitation, data analysis and workshop facilitation skills.
  • Experience working alongside Solution Architects, D365 Developers, Testers, Vendors and business SMEs throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • The ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, practical requirements for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working across Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery environments.
  • Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Visio, Miro and Microsoft Office.

job.title: Lead Engineer
job.description:
Engineering Manager / Lead Engineer
Melbourne preferred | Hybrid

Freight keeps Australia moving. It puts food on supermarket shelves, supplies in hospitals and products in people’s hands. I’m working with a growing SaaS company modernising the technology behind it and changing the industry as we know it.

Their platform connects carriers, customers and business systems, giving companies the visibility and automation to move goods more efficiently.

With plans to expand into the UK and US and significant investment in AI, the business is at a pivotal stage of growth. They’re creating a new engineering leadership role for someone who wants to help shape what comes next.

You won’t be stepping into someone else’s shoes. You’ll have the trust and autonomy to make the role your own, shape how the team works and help build the engineering function as it grows. There’s a real opportunity to improve delivery and engineering practices, influence the platform’s technical direction and help hire the team you’ll lead.

The Technology
We don’t expect you to know it all, but the environment includes:
  • .NET / C# and TypeScript
  • Angular
  • Azure Web Apps and Azure Container Apps
  • Azure Service Bus, queues and distributed systems
  • SQL databases and Cosmos DB
  • Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD and automated testing
  • AI agents, MCP servers and workflow automation
We’re looking for a mix of the following:
  • Experience leading software engineers in a SaaS, product or scaling business.
  • A strong engineering background and the technical credibility to guide architecture, solution design and key decisions.
  • Experience improving delivery, testing, DevOps and release practices.
  • A practical understanding of reliability, security and running services in production.
  • The ability to bring structure and accountability while staying adaptable as the business grows.
  • Curiosity about AI and emerging tools, with a focus on where they can add real value.
You might be an Engineering Manager looking for more ownership, or a Lead Engineer ready to step into broader leadership. You don’t need experience in freight or logistics.

Next steps For more information or to be considered, apply now.

job.title: Software Engineer
job.description:
Senior Embedded Software Engineer – C/C++ | Linux | MedTech

An innovative, venture-backed Australian MedTech company is developing next-generation monitoring technology designed to improve clinical decision-making and patient outcomes during childbirth.

Bringing together specialists across software, hardware, electronics, clinical research and data science, the business is continuing to develop and advance its innovative medical technology.

They are now looking for a Senior Embedded Software Engineer to join their multidisciplinary engineering team.

The Opportunity
This is a hands-on engineering role working across embedded software, hardware and regulated medical-device development.

You will design, develop and test reliable software using C/C++ within Linux and embedded environments. Working alongside firmware, hardware, clinical and regulatory specialists, you will support the development and integration of a complex connected medical device.

What You’ll Be Doing
  • Designing and developing embedded software using C/C++.
  • Working across Linux, RTOS and embedded-device environments.
  • Integrating software with hardware and connected devices.
  • Supporting BLE, NFC and other device communication workflows.
  • Developing unit, integration and system-level tests.
  • Debugging complex software, hardware and connectivity issues.
  • Supporting secure OTA updates, rollback and recovery.
  • Producing documentation and traceability for a regulated medical-device environment.
  • Contributing to software verification and validation activities.
What We’re Looking For
  • Strong commercial C/C++ development experience.
  • Experience working with Linux and embedded systems.
  • Experience integrating software with hardware or connected devices.
  • Knowledge of communication protocols such as BLE, NFC, I2C, SPI or UART.
  • Experience within MedTech, embedded systems or another regulated or safety-critical environment.
  • Experience with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, IEC 60601, Qt/QML, RTOS or secure OTA updates would be advantageous but is not essential.
Why Consider It?
  • Work on technology with the potential to make a meaningful difference to mothers and babies.
  • Solve complex challenges spanning software, hardware and connected devices.
  • Remain deeply hands-on without taking on formal people-management responsibilities.

job.description:
Are you an experienced Work Health and Safety professional looking for an opportunity to make a meaningful impact across a complex and diverse organisation?

This is an opportunity to work with leaders, employees, volunteers and external stakeholders to strengthen safety culture, improve WHS systems and support best-practice health and safety outcomes.

About the Role
As a Senior WHS Advisor, you will provide trusted technical advice and practical support across a broad range of work health and safety matters.
You will contribute to the development, implementation and continuous improvement of WHS systems, policies, procedures and programs, while helping build safety capability and ownership across the organisation.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Providing expert WHS advice and leadership to managers, executives, employees and volunteers.
  • Building strong and productive relationships with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Supporting the development, implementation and maintenance of WHS management systems and strategic work plans.
  • Developing, reviewing and implementing WHS policies, procedures, guidelines and supporting documentation.
  • Monitoring and reporting on hazards, incidents, trends and WHS performance data.
  • Providing advice and reporting to WHS committees and other governance forums.

  • Providing technical advice on WHS legislation, regulations, Australian Standards, codes of practice and organisational policies.
  • Supporting risk management activities and the identification and control of workplace hazards.
  • Contributing to safety initiatives that improve organisational capability, performance and continuous improvement.
  • Monitoring WHS programs and services to ensure agreed outcomes, objectives and performance measures are achieved.
  • Preparing clear, accurate and timely WHS reports, presentations and briefing materials.
  • Supporting and mentoring other WHS professionals and contributing to a collaborative team environment.
About You:

You will be an experienced WHS professional who can operate confidently at both a strategic and operational level.
You will have:
  • Strong knowledge and practical application of Work Health and Safety legislation and associated regulatory requirements.
  • Demonstrated experience providing WHS advice within a complex organisation.
  • Experience developing and maintaining WHS management systems, policies and procedures.
  • Strong understanding of risk management principles and their practical application.
  • Experience conducting or supporting workplace investigations, audits and risk assessments.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyse WHS data, identify trends and prepare meaningful reports.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical information clearly to a range of audiences.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship-building skills.
  • The ability to influence, negotiate and provide credible advice to leaders and operational teams.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
  • A proactive approach to identifying risks, opportunities and areas for improvement.
  • Demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement and building positive safety cultures.
  • The ability to work collaboratively while also operating with a high degree of autonomy.
Experience applying recognised risk management frameworks and public sector WHS, safety, audit, wellbeing or injury management requirements will be highly regarded.

job.title: Senior SAP Functional Consultant

Our client is looking for an experienced Senior SAP Functional Consultant to join the team and play a key role across the Projects / Project Systems stream.

This is a hands-on functional role sitting between the business and technology teams. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to understand business requirements, translate these into SAP solutions and support the design, configuration, implementation and adoption of new capabilities.

What you’ll be doing
  • Support a major global SAP S/4HANA transformation program
  • Lead functional work across SAP Project System (PS)
  • Partner with business teams to understand, analyse and document requirements
  • Configure SAP solutions and contribute to solution design and implementation
  • Work across interconnected modules including SD, FI/CO, PP, MM, EWM, IM and LE
  • Assess and validate functional and technical specifications against business requirements
  • Partner with application and technical specialists throughout delivery
  • Build strong relationships across business and IT stakeholders
  • Support adoption and continuous improvement following implementation
What we’re looking for
  • 3–5+ years' experience working across complex SAP/ERP implementations
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP Project System (PS)
  • At least two SAP PS implementations
  • Configuration experience across S/4HANA and/or ECC 6.0
  • Understanding of how PS integrates with broader SAP modules such as SD, FI/CO, MM, PP, EWM, IM or LE
  • SAP PS or relevant SAP certification highly regarded
  • Strong business analysis, requirements gathering and stakeholder engagement skills
  • Experience working within complex enterprise environments or large transformation programs
Experience across Sales and Finance processes would be particularly valuable.

Why consider it?

job.description:
Digital Workplace Specialist
Melbourne / Sydney / Brisbane

About the Opportunity

An established global professional services organisation is continuing to invest in the technology and digital experiences that support its people across Australia and internationally.

Operating across a large, highly collaborative global environment, the organisation has a strong focus on innovation, technology and improving the way its people work. There is significant investment underway across digital platforms, employee experience and the broader use of technology to create more connected, intuitive and effective ways of working.

Culture is a big part of the environment. The organisation offers genuinely flexible working, places a strong emphasis on learning and development, and encourages people to bring forward ideas rather than simply maintain the status quo.

The Role

This is much more than a traditional SharePoint support role.

Sitting across digital workplace, web, UX and technology, you'll help shape the digital experience used by employees internally while also contributing to the organisation's public-facing digital platforms.

You'll work primarily across SharePoint Online, which supports the organisation's global intranet, alongside Sitecore, which powers its external website.

You'll be hands-on designing and improving SharePoint sites and pages, managing hubs, permissions, content types, lists, libraries and modern web parts, while also supporting ongoing platform changes and strategic initiatives.

On the web side, you'll contribute to page and component configuration, content management and front-end design, working with HTML, CSS, responsive design and UI/UX principles to make sure digital experiences are both functional and intuitive.

There's plenty of variety in the role. One day you may be designing a new intranet experience or improving a user journey, while the next you're supporting a platform issue, delivering a change request, working with stakeholders or helping users get more from the technology available to them.
You'll have the opportunity to influence how these platforms evolve rather than simply keeping the lights on.

We're looking for someone with:
  • Strong hands-on experience with SharePoint Online
  • Experience designing and building modern SharePoint sites and pages
  • Knowledge of hub sites, permissions, content types, lists, libraries and modern web parts
  • Experience working with intranets or employee digital experience platforms
  • Strong web design and UI/UX capability
  • Experience with HTML and CSS
  • An understanding of responsive design and digital design principles
  • Experience working with stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into practical digital solutions
It's a bonus (but not a dealbreaker) if you have experience with a mix of the following:
  • Sitecore
  • Other enterprise Content Management Systems (CMS)
  • Public-facing website management
  • Front-end web development
  • User research or user-centred design
  • Wireframing, prototyping or digital design tools
  • Digital design systems and brand standards
  • SharePoint information architecture
  • Working within a large enterprise or professional services environment
You don't need to tick every box.

We're particularly interested in people who sit somewhere between SharePoint, digital experience and web/UX - someone technical enough to build and support the platforms, but equally comfortable thinking about how people actually experience and use them.

Next Steps

For more information and/or to be considered, apply now.
